text:
olivia park: Quick sync  proposing a micro-campaign 'launch-sprint-surge' — combine a short launch post run, staggered credit seeding, a 20-min benchmark demo, and tightened inbound routing. Main goal: increase time-to-first-use (TTFU) and measure activation velocity. Keep it small and fast. Thoughts?
raj patel: Nice name. Propose staggered credits: 10 credits on signup, +20 after first prompt-run to nudge deeper. Limit initial batch to 300 users, total reserve 9000 tokens. We'll test 2 social creatives and 2 email subject lines.
olivia park: Love staggered release. Who owns routing + cohort tagging?
carmen vega: I'll own routing and cohort. Plan: add utm_campaign=launch_sprint_surge and route signups into cohort `launch_surge_v1`. Pseudocode: 
```yaml
# routing rule (pseudocode)
when: request.query.utm_campaign == 'launch_sprint_surge'
if: request.headers.source in ['twitter','linkedin','dev.to']
action:
  - set user.cohort = 'launch_surge_v1'
  - emit event: 'launch_surge.credit_seeded'
```
ezra white: Landing asks: compress signup to email + password, add inline "Run starter prompt" button on success with preselected starter pack called "quickstart pack". Also include a one-click calendar RSVP. I can ship a lightweight variant to staging.
mia chen: Copy direction: benchmark-story + pragmatic CTA. Lead with a 1-line benchmark: "Ship an AI feature in minutes with starter prompts" then the offer: "10 free credits now + 20 after you run a starter prompt". Email A subject: "10 credits to try Redwood now" Email B: "Finish a quick demo today  30 credits inside" Social A: dev-voice (code screenshot), Social B: founder-voice (use case bullet).
raj patel: Tech notes: backend will grant initial 10 credits on user.create when utm_campaign matches; after event `starter.prompt_run` we'll call credits.grant(+20). We'll expose cohort_id and events in analytics. I'll open infra PR for the staged credit workflow.
olivia park: Measurement plan: funnel = impression -> signup -> initial prompt-run -> second prompt-run after top-up. Key metrics: TTFU median, prompt-run rate (24h), activation velocity (time to second run), and webinar RSVP->attendance. Also capture qualitative feedback after the second run: 2-question micro-survey.
carmen vega: One routing nuance: apply `launch_surge_v1_beta` tag for first 150 users and `launch_surge_v1_exp` for the other 150 to test CTA copy differences in-app.
ezra white: UX experiment: in-app CTA variants: A) big primary button "Run quickstart pack" B) inline code block + small CTA "Try sample code". We'll randomize on signup.
mia chen: We'll prepare a short benchmark narrative for the demo: show a feature built in 8 minutes, cost estimate for tokens, and a before/after latency/cost slide. This will be our primary webinar hook.
scheduler-bot: Reminder: campaign orchestration needs 48 hours lead time. Please confirm final launch window.
raj patel: Timeline: prep Mon, soft launch Wed 9am PT to 300 impressions, measure 72h. Webinar Thu 11am PT: 20-min benchmark demo + 10-min Q&A. Decision gate: if prompt-run rate (24h) increases by >=15% vs baseline, scale to 5k impressions.
olivia park: Decision: proceed. Seed 300 users with stagger: 10 immediate + 20 post-run. @carmen add routing + cohort tags, @raj open PR for credit automation, @mia drop benchmark copy + two subject lines by EOD. Scheduler-bot  schedule check 48h before launch. :rocket:
carmen vega: Adding routing rule and cohort tags now. I'll create two cohort buckets per the split.
raj patel: Opening PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/998 — includes staged credit workflow and analytics hooks.
mia chen: Drafts posted to #marketing-drafts: social A/B, email A/B, and the benchmark storyline slide deck (short).
ezra white: Staging landing variant live at /launch-sprint-staging. Buttons wired for randomized CTA.
scheduler-bot: Check scheduled: 2024-08-05T09:00:00Z (48h pre-check created).
olivia park: Nice execution. Keep cohort small and instrument everything. If we get clean signal, iterate messaging and scale. Thanks team! :sparkles:
